text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is here!
I want to make sure we train hard and build up strength for the autumn!

While feeling that fiery spirit from the Umamusume,
inside the bus, as expected—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: When I'm happy, it's pyoi-pyoi-pyoi! When I'm surprised, it's whoooosh!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Why!? When Turbo is happy she goes 'pyoi pyoi', and when she's surprised she goes 'buwawa~' too!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If we're talking about that, maybe I am too?
In terms of nuance, at least.
It was as lively a scene as ever.
